info.name: The New York Times Archive Movies API
Get Movie Critics Name, Bio And Image

params.name: reviewer
params.description: Reviewer name or "all" for all reviewers, "full-time" for full-time reviewers, or "part-time" for part-time reviewers.

items.docs: Get movie critics. You can either specify the reviewer name or use "all", "full-time", or "part-time".

params.name: type
params.description: Filter by critics' pick or not.

params.name: offset
params.description: Sets the starting point of the result set.  Needs to be multiple of 20.

items.docs:
Get movie reviews.  Can filter to only return Critics' Picks.
Supports ordering results by-publication-date or by-opening-date.
Use offset to paginate thru results, 20 at a time.

params.name: critics-pick
params.description: Set to Y to only show critics' picks.  Otherwise shows both.

params.name: offset
params.description: Sets the starting point of the result set (0, 20, ...).  Used to paginate thru results. Defaults to 0. The has_more field indicates the response has more results.

params.name: opening-date
params.description: U.S. opening date range. Start and end dates separated by colon (e.g. 1930-01-01:1940-01-01).

params.name: order
params.description: Field to order results by (e.g. by-publication-date).

params.name: publication-date
params.description: Review publication date range. Start and end dates separated by colon (e.g. 1930-01-01:1940-01-01).

params.name: reviewer
params.description: Filter by reviewer byline (e.g. Stephen Holden).

items.docs: Search for movie reviews.  Supports filtering by Critics' Pick.
